policy: Exact Stage 19 outcomes use mathematics-aware diagnostic/adaptive decisions. The engine consumes five audited signals and fails closed on incomplete, mixed, or contract-inconsistent exact state. Legacy non-migrated outcomes retain the Phase 35 behavior until explicitly migrated.
prerequisitePolicy: Prerequisite mastery is supplied by an audited curriculum/learning-state source. Stage 20 does not invent prerequisite SkillIds or infer a prerequisite graph from lesson text.
representationPolicy: Representation fluency entries must map only to question families already allowed by the exact Stage 19 Outcome/SkillContract.
misconceptionPolicy: Misconception history may target only an allowed exact question family; an active incorrect-response misconception is prioritized deterministically.

complexityPolicy.note: Internal target complexity is retained independently from the Easy/Medium/Challenging UI projection.
